document_metadata.document_title: SUDAS Design Manual — Chapter 2 Stormwater (city uses SUDAS + ISWMM)

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Davenport follows statewide SUDAS Design Manual Chapter 2 and Iowa Stormwater Management Manual (ISWMM) for post-construction practices. SUDAS defines Water Quality Volume (WQv) and Recharge Volume (Rev) plus conveyance/detention (2G); ISWMM guides practice sizing.
peak_flow_calculation_method: Minor design storm (generally 2- to 10-year) for conveyance
Major design storm (typically 100-year) for flood routing
